thread:
Elaine (CSE): Quick sync — Marigold dedicated pool onboarding tomorrow 09:00 PT. Quotas currently at 120k tokens/min burst cap, customer asking for 250k. Need: quota plan, autoscale policy review, and a smoke loadtest cadence. Who can own?
Matt (CS Ops): I can own the quota plan doc. Do we have historical traffic profile from their sandbox? want p95 vs peak?
Elaine (CSE): Got a brief from AE: steady baseline ~60k tpm during business hours, spikes up to ~220k during bulk ops windows (10–15m). They expect growth on day 1 after launch. Renewal risk if we get throttled.
Devin (SRE): Re: autoscale — current pool autoscaler uses slot-based scaling with a 3-min cool-down. For bursts to 250k we should: bump max slots from 8->12, reduce cool-down to 90s, add a short-lived burst tier (pre-warmed slot) for the first 10 minutes of traffic. Also recommend prefix KV priming.
Sam (Infra Eng): Command to run a smoke generator we've used before:
```bash
# small smoke run (10m)
./tools/loadgen --target-pool marigold --qps 1800 --duration 600 --payload-pattern mix_short_long
```
Would like to run a 30m soak at ~200k tokens/min after quota bump. I can schedule at 08:00 PT if we lock config by 07:30.
Elaine (CSE): @Matt locking config likely needs customer sign-off; AE said they'll approve quota bump if we provide a fallback plan and SLO notes. Matt — can you draft the one-pager? Include rollback steps and cost delta.
Matt (CS Ops): Yep; I'll put a one-pager in the shared folder in 30m. Outline: target quotas, autoscale params, pre-warm plan, rollback (scale to 6 slots + route to fallback v2), expected cost impact (~+18% for first week).
capacity-bot: Scheduled loadtest window created by Sam: 2024-07-05T08:00:00-07:00 (30m). Channel: #customer-success.
Devin (SRE): Also add health checks for KV cache hit rate and token tail latency. If tail latency > 800ms for >5% of requests during soak, auto-abort and route to fallback model.
Sam (Infra Eng): I'll wire the abort hook into the run script. Quick snippet I'll use for the abort check:
```bash
# abort if tail latency exceeds threshold
if curl -s http://metrics/api/p95 > 800; then ./tools/loadgen --abort; fi
```
Elaine (CSE): Nice. Postmortem ask: capture any instances of model fallback and user-visible errors. AE will use that for renewal talk.
Matt (CS Ops): Uploading draft one-pager now: https://internal.redwood/documents/marigold-quota-onepager (will update with numbers after soak). :thumbsup:
Devin (SRE): I can shadow the soak and watch autoscaler metrics (slot count, queue length, KV hit). Ping me in this thread when it starts.
Elaine (CSE): Final checklist: 1) Customer sign-off on quota (+250k burst) — AE ✅ pending, 2) Matt one-pager — in progress, 3) Autoscale config change — Sam -> apply by 07:30, 4) Pre-warm run — Sam to provision 2 pre-warm slots at 07:50, 5) Soak & abort hooks — Devin watching. If all good we'll flip traffic 10:00 PT.
Sam (Infra Eng): Affirmative. I'll post final config diff before 07:30.
Elaine (CSE): Thanks team. Low friction ask from customer: can we run a short dry-run tonight at 22:00 PT (non-production) to rehearse rollback?
Matt (CS Ops): I can coordinate tonight but limit to 10m and conservative QPS.
Devin (SRE): I'll join the dry-run too. Add me to calendar invite.
Elaine (CSE): Adding calendar, tagging AE to confirm. Marking thread for follow-up after dry-run. :spiral_calendar:
